profile.ja: 対魔忍を率いる総隊長にして最強の対魔忍と目されている正義のくノ一。カオス・アリーナでの死闘で朧を倒すも恋人・沢木恭介を失う。自身も死闘の中で朧に囚われ、邪悪な魔界医療技術によって肉体を淫らに改造されるも、７年前に捕虜にした魔科医・桐生の手によって元の肉体に治療されている。天才的な剣術と体術、人知を超える光速のスピードが武器。また、東京キングダムの死闘では対魔忍の中に潜む真正の魔の力に覚醒し、その能力を格段に向上させて「隼の術」極意を体得する。政府によって設立された対魔忍養成学校・五車学園の校長を務めている。得物は忍者刀。
profile.en: (Igawa Asagi, she/her) Asagi Igawa is a justice-driven kunoichi who leads the Taimanin as the supreme commander and is regarded as the strongest Taimanin. In a fierce battle at the Chaos Arena she defeats Oboro but loses her lover, Sawaki Kyousuke. She herself is captured by Oboro during the fight and her body is lewdly altered with evil Demon Realm medical technology, yet seven years later a captive demon scientist, Kiryu, restores her to her original form. She wields genius-level swordsmanship, unparalleled martial arts, and light-speed speed as her weapons. During the deadly clashes of Tokyo Kingdom she awakens the true demonic power hidden within Taimanin, dramatically enhancing her abilities and mastering the ultimate "Falcon Technique." She serves as principal of Gosha Academy, the government-established Taimanin training school, and her weapon of choice is a ninja sword.

text.ja: 「対魔忍、井河アサギよ。対魔忍の隊長の実力、教えてあげるわ」
text.en: Taimanin, it's Igawa Asagi. I'll teach you what a Taimanin commander can do.

text.ja: 状況はどうなっている？　先を読み先手を打っていくのが大切よ
text.en: What's the situation? It's important to read ahead and take the initiative.

text.ja: ふふふ、ご苦労様。あまり根を詰めないようにしなさい
text.en: Hehe, good work. Don't push yourself too hard.

text.ja: ……何をしているのかしら？　今それが必要があるとは思わないわ
text.en: …What are you doing? I don't think that's necessary right now.

text.ja: ちょっと、ここ間違っているわよ。しっかりしなさい
text.en: Hey, this is wrong. Pull yourself together.

text.ja: はあ……ああ、大丈夫よ。対魔忍は個性の強い子が多いから、まとめるのはちょっと大変だけど
text.en: Haa…yeah, it's fine. Taimanin have a lot of strong personalities, so keeping them together can be a bit tough.

text.ja: 魔の物を討つ、それが対魔忍、それが私対魔忍アサギよ！
text.en: Hunting down demonic things, that's what Taimanin do, that's me, Taimanin Asagi!

text.ja: 対魔忍アサギ推参！　悪しき魑魅魍魎共覚悟しろ！
text.en: Taimanin Asagi reporting! Evil youkai, prepare yourselves!
